**Puzzle Details**

- **Theme/Title:**
- **Grid Size:** (e.g., 10x10, 15x15)

**Testing Checklist**
Please confirm the following before submitting:

- [ ] I have added my puzzle to `puzzles.py` following the existing JSON structure.
- [ ] I have run `uv run main.py` and successfully played through my entire puzzle.
- [ ] All clues fit within the UI without cutting off.
- [ ] All intersecting across/down answers match up perfectly.

**Are you ready to submit a Pull Request?**

- [ ] Yes, I have the code ready and will open a PR referencing this issue.
- [ ] No, I just want to provide the raw JSON/text here for someone else to implement.

**Additional Notes**
Any fun facts about this puzzle? Let us know!
